note: 523264 * 65536 + 1024 * 33554432 = 68652367872 payload bytes in 524288 allocations at one call site. An allocation of size s has sampling probability p = 1 - exp(-s / L), where L is the sampling interval. Estimated totals are sums of 1/p for count and s/p for bytes over sampled allocations: in expectation, p * (1/p) = 1 and p * (s/p) = s. At L = 4 MiB, relative standard deviations are 1.10% for count and 0.55% for bytes; the 6% margins exceed five standard deviations. String headers add less than 0.1%.
